LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DeathField.label: <color=#E85A7A>Deathflow Field</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DeathField.description: Creates a radius-9 Death Sentence field for 9 seconds. Non-immune units other than the caster are slowed by 20%, receive cuts and gain 1 accumulation each second. At 9 points they are executed; a successful execution grants 1 Karma and 5 Deathward counters. Accumulation rapidly decays outside the field. Cooldown: 40 seconds. Neiyu, Qinghe, Zhaoli and Mingyuan are immune to its accumulation, slow, cuts and execution.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Guiyi.label: <color=#C77DFF>Uncanny Remedy</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Guiyi.description: Costs 3 Karma to restore missing parts, wounds and treatable harmful conditions, and creates a 30-day Karma Link. At most 6 targets can be linked. Cannot target the caster or enemies. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Dingshu.label: <color=#C9A2FF>Fixed Fate</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Dingshu.description: Costs 8 Karma and channels for about 34.7 seconds to resurrect and repair a corpse, creating a Karma Link and a 3-day Destiny Mark. A target that dies again while marked cannot be resurrected again. Unavailable during raids.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minghuo.label: <color=#FF6A6A>Netherflame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minghuo.description: Costs 3 Karma to enchant the current primary weapon for 60 seconds. Damage, armor penetration, hit chance and attack speed increase by 25%, melee reach increases by 1 cell, and melee hits add fire damage. Cooldown: 150 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minshen.label: <color=#C77DFF>Mind-Effacement</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Minshen.description: Costs 3 Karma and affects enemies in a 13×13 area. Flesh targets take 1 armor-ignoring damage to the torso each second for 5 seconds, and have a 10% chance to become dazed for 7 seconds; otherwise their movement falls by 45% for 7 seconds. Non-flesh targets receive EMP. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Duanzhan.label: <color=#E85A7A>Severing Slash</color>
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_Duanzhan.description: After briefly lowering the blade, Zhaoli releases a <color=#E85A7A>severing arc</color> that sweeps through enemies ahead in violet-white light. Targets on the central line take heavier cutting damage. If <color=#FF6A6A>Netherflame</color> is still bound to the weapon, a small amount of flame damage is added.
